notes.title: Update 0.7.7 - Lights, Camera, KO! - LIV LCK Integration Live!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Update 0.7.7 – Lights, Camera… KO! – Patch Notes
We’ve got a slick new update that’s tailor-made for content creators, streamers, and anyone who wants to show off their moves in style.

FINAL FURY v0.7.7 introduces LIV LCK integration, unlocking cinematic camera tools and custom sequence options to help you capture the perfect angle, whether you're teaching combos, breaking down fights, or just flexing your KO reel.

You can now set up multi-angle sequences inside Training Mode, choosing between predefined shots or crafting your own setups. Activate LIV in Settings and you’re ready to roll. It’s the perfect combo of fighter and filmmaker.

And of course, this patch isn’t just about the cameras. We’ve also ironed out some bugs, cleaned up audio transitions, and made sure Diesel’s Slash’n’Dice doesn’t get in a dance battle with his walk animation anymore.

Full patch notes below, grab your headset and go make some magic!

New Feature
LIV LCK Integration: Creators, this one's for you! Record cinematic gameplay using LIV’s camera and sequence configurator.

Set up your own camera angles and sequences in Training Mode

Choose from preset or custom views

Activate LIV and your sequence in the Settings menu

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that caused players to stay in third-person view unexpectedly

Fixed Diesel’s Slash'n'Dice animation overlapping with his walk cycle

Fixed an issue where Voice Chat continued to behave oddly when disabled

Fixed character animations restarting when stopping movement

Polish and Audio

Music and audio now fade smoothly when changing scenes

The announcer no longer calls out combos after a KO

Added SFX to the Reward Popup

notes.title: Update 0.7.6 - Ready to Fight Round 2 - Live Now!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes – v0.7.6

NEW FEATURE: Arcade Mode while “Ready to Fight”

You asked for it—and we heard you loud and clear. After loads of community feedback following 0.7.4, we’ve made it happen: you can now queue for Quick Match and play Arcade Mode at the same time!

That means you can stay sharp and earn unlocks while you wait. Speaking of…

Arcade Mode Unlocks


 Unlock 3 Chromas per character by completing each difficulty tier.
 Beat the full Arcade Mode to unlock Valdan and his fiery arena, Hellmouth.


So whether you're perfecting your combos or just vibing through the story—there’s plenty to earn while matchmaking.

Gameplay Improvements


 Fixed an issue where gestures (especially grabs) wouldn’t register correctly if you started the game off-center and didn’t recenter.
 Fixed a bug where getting knocked down mid-grab left you stuck in an out-of-body state.
 AI improvements: opponents now recognize repeated grab attempts and adapt their strategy. Sorry, grab spammers.

notes.title: 0.7.5 - Feel the Fury - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Ever wish you could really feel that knockout punch land? Or sense the hum of power surging through your arms as you charge up a special? Well, wish granted. As of update 0.7.5, FINAL FURY now supports bHaptics gear—starting with the TactSuit™ and TactSleeve™.

Stay tuned for a more in-depth blog coming soon!

Patch Notes – v0.7.5

Features and Improvements
– Added bHaptics support

notes.title: 0.7.4 - Ready to Fight - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURE: "Ready to Fight"

You can now queue for Quick Match multiplayer while playing Versus or Training mode! No more staring at the matchmaking screen while you wait—stay active, warm up, or experiment with your moves until an opponent is found.

Arcade Mode is not currently compatible with this feature. But if this is something you’d like to see added, let us know in Discord! It would take a bit more development time, but we want to hear if it’s worth pursuing.

Patch Notes – v0.7.4

Features and Improvements
– New “Ready to Fight” system: queue for Quick Match while playing Versus or Training.
– Improved visual fidelity across all arenas on the Quest version.
– Adjusted Out Of Body camera angle for more dramatic perspective.

Gesture System Improvements
– Changed priority between Punch, Grab, Arctic Blast, and Crystalize: Arctic Blast and Grab now take priority over Crystalize.
– Increased gesture forgiveness for Arctic Blast and Grab.
– Decreased gesture tolerance for UpToDown and DownToUp motions to make them more deliberate.

Affected moves:
– Tempest’s Crystalize
– Niko’s Hammer Punch
– Gaia’s Tectonic Shift and Nature’s Retribution
– Valdan’s Ancestral Flame

Balance Changes
– Valdan’s Ancestral Flame: reduced knockdown time, increased cooldown.
– Tempest’s Crystalize: slightly higher cooldown.

Bug Fixes
– Fixed Out Of Body camera angle issue.
– Fixed bugs related to analytics.
– Fixed bug where Arcade Ladder could end prematurely.

Known Issues
– Occasionally, the grab gesture may stop detecting until the game is recentered.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.3.25343p Changelog
notes.notes:
- Fixed support for Quest Pro devices.
- Fixed issues with some HTC Vive devices.

notes.title: 🍃FINAL FURY Gaia Update - Live Now!
notes.notes:
Hey Fighters! 👊

Three fearsome warriors already stepped up to claim the title of FINAL FURY Champion: Niko, Tempest, and Glitch.

Today, we’re making each of them even more powerful, adding additional high-risk, high-reward power moves while introducing another new gladiator: Gaia.

Best of all, you can experience it all for yourself, right now in-game! So, while the app updates, keep reading for the inside scoop.

New Fighter: Gaia - Nature’s Fury Incarnate!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/7dce8a98a170cf673332c7eb7636bca95e998ed8.jpg

Gaia’s an unstoppable force. Honed in countless battles, she’s a powerhouse tapping into her nature-inspired abilities. As a warrior hailing from a lush jungle planet, she comes to the arena ready to literally control the arena with her powers!

 🪨 Tectonic Shift: A long-range AOE that unleashes a cascade of damaging rocks in a straight line. (Performed by moving both hands top to bottom.)
 🌿 Nature's Retribution: A tracking vine that homes in on opponents, rooting them in place and leaving them vulnerable. (Performed with a one-hand bottom-to-top gesture.)

Stick around, because we’re going to have a deeper dive with the devs into how you can make the most of Gaia’s powers in a separate blog coming in the next couple of days!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/9b9104eb228c68c89acda6d1010f7460322ce090.gif

New Powers for Returning Favorites

Whether you prefer long-range precision, close-quarters dominance, or strategic setups, there’s now even more to explore and master with the Characters we’ve already introduced. Let’s take a look at the next wave of powers you can now try out in the latest Playtest Update.

❄️ Tempest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/990efe1f163eb84204262e8c4962b6ffb9868b5b.gif

Tempest's icy powers are now even more versatile as the game’s all-rounder. Attack from a medium distance launching Arctic Blasts or control the zone in front of yourself with her new move, Crystalize.  

Arctic Blast: A projectile attack, performed with the iconic Hadoken gesture.

Crystalize (NEW): A cone-shaped AOE attack in front of the player that’s both powerful and visually stunning. Performed by moving one hand from bottom to top. It gives off summoning power vibes when you do it.

🤖 Glitch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/ad54ce3e4ba9534f63b2eab5a9206d7a2062de07.gif

Glitch’s tech-centric arsenal introduces new tactical options. With its launchers, there’s no need for gestures—just precision aiming and timing.

Tac-Bomb: Deploy up to three bombs that stay active on the floor, detonating when triggered by proximity. (Performed by using the GRIP + Trigger of the Right Controller.)

Homing Missile (NEW): Fire, point, and destroy what you see. A slow-moving, tracking projectile that hunts down opponents, the explosion creates a smoke cloud that you can use to your advantage! Performed by using the GRIP + Trigger of the Left Controller.

⚡ Niko

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/49d1994f8fc0c7e58e1786ce867440db61495010.gif

A nimble street brawler, Niko thrives in high-energy, up-close combat. His abilities favor aggressive players who want to control the tempo of a fight. So OF COURSE we had to amp up his skills with Shockwave.

Proton Punch: A devastatingly quick, heavy-hitting attack. (Performed by moving both hands top to bottom.)

Shockwave (NEW): A close-range Area of Effect (AOE) attack, perfect for disrupting opponents. Performed by charging your hands in front of you and releasing forward.

New Stage: Predatorium – Spiritual Crucible

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/a5f6c508912be50a7b6681f035381366ccafbb57.jpg

Welcome to Predatorium—a lush, temple-cloaked jungle nestled deep within the wilds of Mawuli, where warriors clash to earn the favor (and ferocity) of the ancient force known as Ku Yig.

Don’t let the serene waterfalls and emerald canopies fool you—this isn’t a vacation, it’s a trial by combat. A sharp contrast to FINAL FURY’s high-tech arenas, Predatorium brings the brawl back to nature—raw, untamed, and utterly unforgiving.

Only the worthy leave this crucible standing. The rest? Fertilizer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/506858b2a6cafe199a02968737329560d4e385b3.jpg

Patch Notes Highlights

🛡️ Blocking movement speed reduced – less backpedaling, more commitment

🏃 Character mobility tuned – Niko now moves significantly faster

🌋 Tectonic Shift can now be charged

 Lvl 1: Short range, basic damage
 Lvl 2: Medium range, increased damage
 Lvl 3: Long range, higher damage + knockdown

✊ General punch damage reduced – less button mash, more brain bash

🤼 Grab tweaks – distance, speed, and reach refined across the roster

💠 Health stat renamed to Defense – now better reflects block strength, damage resistance, and defensive traits

The Melee is about to Begin!

From here on out, the updates are going to be coming fast and…well…furious. We’ve got more fighters and more features custom-built for competition on the way. Speaking of which, did you know we have a tournament coming up?

That’s right, we’re firing up a community challenge! It’s YOU against the devs, the best players are competing for prizes…and a chance to to join a future “Celebrity Deathmatch.” Sorry we gotta be cryptic about that last bit for now.

Jump over to Discord or register directly on Challonge – there’s still time to sign up (and get more details about what’s happening)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/ab4657a3831971a9c739b244159b8f06afa92914.png

Wishlist FINAL FURY now!

Liked what you've seen so far? Simply hitting the "Add to Wishlist" button is a huge help for us! “How,” you ask?


 Every wishlist means we get more visibility in the digital storefronts.
 It shows demand for competitive VR fighting!
 You get update news, first!

We say it a LOT here, but your support truly means the world to us.

Steam Wishlist

Fight on,
The FINAL FURY Team

notes.title: ⚡FINAL FURY Niko Update - Live Now!
notes.notes:
Hey Fighters! 👊

The FINAL FURY Alpha Playtest is about to amp things up with our first major update which goes live TODAY!

We’ve got game-changing combat mechanics, a new challenger, and a new stage coming your way. All the news you need’s right here, below!  Tomorrow we’re giving a deeper-dive look at the strategies and tactics you could use with Niko, the cybernetic-armed slugger!

Sparked your interest? Find more information (and electric puns) below…

New Fighter: Niko - Lightning-Fast and Hard-Hitting

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/6ecb11ea530bebc8c1385f59ca349f5289686744.jpg

Ready to bring some high-voltage energy into the ring? Then Niko’s your new main! We’re giving you a quick look now, but look for tomorrow’s post where the devs give you some serious corner tactics on how to REALLY punish opponents as Niko!

Niko’s hit-and-run playstyle has you hammering opponents with his gorilla-like fists, then bounce out before anyone can react. 


 ⚡ Phase Dash – Niko’s dashes chain together, letting him phase straight through obstacles! Projectiles, bomb triggers? They don’t even touch him. Blink, and he’s already on the other side, ready to strike!
 ⚡ Proton Punch – His signature move is a short-range strike packed with raw energy, capable 


If you love speed, unpredictability, and rushing that @#!$ down, you need to try this electrifying scrapper!

Check out Niko by joining the Alpha Playtest NOW!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/78a23003bbebf9adc9bca500d7631740454c9841.gif

🛡️ New Universal Move – Reversal Shield: Defense Just Got Dangerous

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/290e2dfe2dfe0ab6c86452faca0aad0a4e2df793.gif

Rushdown players beware—FINAL FURY just got a game-changing new mechanic that flips the script on relentless pressure. Introducing the Reversal Shield, a universal countermeasure designed to add more depth to defensive play and stop mindless aggression in its tracks.

REVERSAL SHIELD’S IMPACT ON GAMEPLAY:


 💥 Absorb attacks and charge your shield
 💥 Unleash a shockwave to push back aggressive opponents
 💥 Destroys projectiles and creates space to reset the fight
 💥 Be Careful—mistime it, and you’ll be punished hard


Ever felt trapped in an opponent’s endless barrage with no way to fight back? That ends now.

The Reversal Shield lets you charge up energy as you absorb attacks. Time it right, and you can release a shockwave that destroys incoming projectiles and knocks back opponents, flipping momentum in an instant.

The Reversal Shield isn’t just defense—it’s a weapon. Use it wisely, and you’ll turn an opponent’s offense into your opportunity. Get ready to level up your strategy. 

🏭 New Stage: Cybernetics Lab – A High-Tech Battleground

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/793d53e8a038d010b8646224ebc4b6fcc16db1aa.jpg

Niko’s “Home” – the cybernetic labs where he was given his Vygor-power arms – is also his personal training ground. More accurately, it’s his QA testing room and his opponents are the test subjects.

Don’t get distracted by all the electronics and screens humming around the room, because Niko’s coming straight at you, full force and full speed!

🧠 Harder, Better, Faster, Smarter – The FINAL FURY AI Just Leveled Up

Think you’ve got the single player mode all figured out? Not anymore. FINAL FURY’s latest update brings a complete AI overhaul, making every fight more unpredictable, more strategic, and more intense.


 🔥 5 Difficulty Levels – From casual warm-ups to the ultimate challenge, can you handle the heat? 🧠 Smarter AI  – No more simple robotic patterns. The AI analyzes your playstyle in real time, adapting its approach to keep you on your toes. Every fight feels fresh and unique—no two matches will play out the same.
 ☯️ Adaptive Combat – The AI evolves mid-fight, adjusting its strategy based on how you play. That one trick you kept using? It won’t work forever. Stay sharp, or get outplayed.


Thanks to Our Playtesters, Leaving Everything on the Mat

Everything you’ve read here, couldn’t be possible without the continued playtesting that’s been happening. Everyone reading this and joining our tests is having a lasting impact on FINAL FURY’s development – and for that, we can’t thank you enough! 

This update brings a serious jolt to the FINAL FURY Alpha Playtest, and we can’t wait to see what new strategies and insane fights come out of it. 

Whether you’re mastering Niko’s mobility or perfecting your Reversal Shield mind games, it’s time to level up your play and what better way to do that than together!

🔥 Invite your friends — Join our Discord to gain access for your and your buddies

👀 Keep an eye out — More updates, tournaments, and surprises coming soon!

Fight on,
The FINAL FURY Team

notes.title: 🥊Dev Blog: Back in the Fight Update!
notes.notes:
WELCOME, FIGHTERS!

It’s been a while, we know. You’re wondering what’s going on with the development of FINAL FURY and we appreciate your patience. So, here’s the deal:

Building a Better VR Fighting Game

For the past six months, we’ve been heads-down, making some massive changes to FINAL FURY. We’re talking a complete overhaul of the game’s core systems, mechanics, and overall feel. Here’s a quick tale of the tape:


New Combat System: We’ve redesigned the combat UI, removing distracting elements that detract from the fight, putting you more in control and in the moment. The orbs are gone in favor of landing direct blows guided by your own hands!
Multiplayer Improvements: We rewrote the networking code based on beta feedback. We’re now using rollback baby! Our goal: Allow you to play with fighters from different regions without a hitch.
Physical Impact: We’ve focused on making the fighters feel more physical. Animations are now more impactful, making you feel like you’re really in the fight. When you land a hit, you’ll know your opponent feels it.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/2d85f776a1bee63555c558f3a61b1d5bb567bb41.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/fb86d0b92d2edae66b2675929322a49d80946558.gif

"When it comes to creating an arcade-style fighting game, having the right feel is incredibly important. We've taken that time to do this right—to make sure that every part of FINAL FURY feels fresh and exciting. It’s been a lot of work, no doubt, but the results are what matter.”

-Seb, Game Design Director

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/2d85f776a1bee63555c558f3a61b1d5bb567bb41.png

What’s Coming Next

Here’s our promise to you:  We’ll be dropping new content regularly as we build up to something really special in a couple of months. 

Here’s what’s coming: 


Regular Updates: We’ll start sharing updates more often, with behind-the-scenes tours, dev insights, and deeper looks at FINAL FURY’s fight card.
Community Fun: We’re planning some cool community events and Q&A sessions with the dev team. We want to keep you in the loop and get your feedback!
Big Reveal: All of this is leading up to something pretty cool. Trust us, it’s gonna be awesome!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/2d85f776a1bee63555c558f3a61b1d5bb567bb41.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/8ecbdc89bc113adc892402322f892c9ad52a8fda.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/5f48f641116d0b660dcc0773fe7b0acac68f616c.gif

"You folks mean the world to us, and we’ve been working hard to make sure FINAL FURY lives up to your expectations. We can’t wait to show you what we’ve been up to and hear what you think."
-Rob, Producer

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/2d85f776a1bee63555c558f3a61b1d5bb567bb41.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/23da94050c3c542f9939fc3db2477c20e1c9bc96.gif

Join the FINAL FURY Leagu..(We mean, Discord)!

We’re pumped for what’s next!This is just the start of us, reconnecting with you. We’ve got more blogs coming that’ll dive deeper into the new features, character designs, and the revamped combat system.

As we gear up, drop in our Discord and jump into the chat to share your thoughts and hype. Your feedback is super important as we move forward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459530/4d36ae4b5c957b16e49e25b829c2e4f693184593.png

Thanks so much for sticking with us.

Stay tuned and keep fighting!

–The FINAL FURY Team
